name: Light's Justice

angles.text: Forsaken bodies cannot regrow decaying flesh on their own. Gathering limbs from Scourge remnants is a grim necessity to keep wounded Forsaken and soldiers whole.
Morbin Lightbane calls himself a paladin of the Forsaken. His example shows holy warfare and martial duty enduring in undeath under the Dark Lady's service.
Securing the Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity protects the Horde's vital northern capital and strengthens its fragile hold in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.answer: Morbin Lightbane is a Forsaken paladin who lives in the Undercity. He carries out Lady Sylvanas's will by tending to his kin's physical survival and honoring his fallen captain, Garek Bandarion.
Forsaken flesh decays and cannot heal or knit itself together. Intact limbs gathered from fallen undead in the ruins above can repair damaged bodies and help keep their fighting forces active.
Captain Garek Bandarion was a commander devoted to cleansing Lordaeron of Scourge remnants and healing his Forsaken kin. His followers carry on that work in his memory.
Scourge forces wander the Ruins of Lordaeron, the surface city directly above the Undercity. Forsaken efforts to purge them continue, but the invaders remain dangerous in number.
faq.q: Where are the Scourge forces located?

faq.answer: Morbin Lightbane calls himself a paladin of the Forsaken. He directs his martial devotion toward serving Sylvanas Windrunner and protecting his people.
faq.q: Are there paladins among the Forsaken?

aliases: why is it called lights justice
faq.answer: For Morbin Lightbane, justice means driving the mindless Scourge from Lordaeron's capital and using their remains to save the Forsaken.
faq.q: What does 'Light's Justice' signify for the Forsaken?

sections.body: Above the Undercity, Scourge remnants still prowl the ruined streets of Lordaeron's former capital. Though the Dark Lady has defeated the dreadlords and founded the Forsaken kingdom, clearing the surface remains costly work. The undead threaten the gateway below and drain the forces sent to reclaim the fallen kingdom.
sections.title: The Scourge Above

sections.body: Forsaken bodies do not mend on their own. Rotting tissue and shattered sinew cannot knit again, so Morbin Lightbane sends warriors to gather intact limbs from destroyed Scourge in the ruins above. Those parts can repair wounded Forsaken and help them endure and fight again.
sections.title: Flesh and Bone

sections.body: Morbin Lightbane honors his late commander, Captain Garek Bandarion, by carrying on this work. Bandarion pledged to heal their people and free Lordaeron from Scourge occupation. To Morbin, destroying their mindless enemies and restoring their kin is justice in the service of the Banshee Queen.
sections.title: A Captain's Legacy

summary: In the Undercity, Morbin Lightbane sends warriors above to gather what the Forsaken need. Intact limbs from the Scourge in the Ruins of Lordaeron help repair wounded Forsaken and sustain their ranks.
